verdict.rationale: Mem0's own docs describe a product called 'Mem0 Open Source', the same memory engine as the Platform, which you self-host while owning 'the stack, the data, and every component'. That implies the source is openly available, but the pack never names a license or points to a readable source repository. missing for 10: a named open-source license (e.g. Apache/MIT), a link to the public source repository, independent confirmation that the code can be read and audited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Mem0 Open Source is the same memory engine as the Platform, running on your own infrastructure. You own the stack, the data, and every component
Self-host Mem0 with full control over your infrastructure and data
